name: PR Readiness Router

findings.description: The PR readiness reviewer role, routing policy, and decision schema are present and distinguish PR readiness from lead-review quality judgment.
findings.does_not_block: Does not authorize product, diagnostics, mastery, PV, Scale Gate 1, generated-output, or student/product use authority.
findings.proof_required_to_close: Policy, schema, and agent role remain in the diff and lead review round 2 closes PASS WITH FLAGS.

findings.description: The pure router classifies ready, revise, batch, human-review, and pause/escalate routes with stale-proof and fail-closed safeguards.
findings.does_not_block: Does not auto-merge or bypass branch protection for L3/L4 or governance changes.
findings.proof_required_to_close: Focused Jest suite and check:pr-readiness pass.

findings.description: The live collector is read-only and the executor applies only explicit, current-head marker-comment and draft-ready transitions.
findings.does_not_block: Does not make merge or approval decisions.
findings.proof_required_to_close: Fixture reviewer and dry-run executor commands pass; final live PR run must post/update a GitHub marker comment rather than commit per-head decision artifacts.

findings.description: The L0/L1/L2 throughput helper constructors are added and normalized by the router.
findings.does_not_block: Does not grant L3/L4 autonomous readiness.
findings.proof_required_to_close: Helper tests and direct helper-output router tests pass.

findings.description: Branch protection remains strict, with one approving review required and bypass allowances not observable through the inspected response.
findings.blocks: Automated merge identity or bypass design for future lead-only lanes.
findings.does_not_block: Does not block marking a draft ready for human review.
findings.proof_required_to_close: Repository owner or future infrastructure sprint decides whether service identity or explicit bypass rules are needed.

findings.description: This governance implementation PR remains human-review-required.
findings.blocks: Autonomous merge of this governance change.
findings.does_not_block: Does not block routing the draft PR to READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW and marking it ready.
findings.proof_required_to_close: Final PR-readiness run routes the implementation PR to human review after remote CI/checker evidence.

findings.description: Post-review trust-boundary hardening keeps remote-derived GitHub evidence immutable, removes synthetic autonomous proof, requires validate-platform, verifies evidence tails by comparison, and adds final transition re-fetch.
findings.blocks: None after final exact-head lead review and PR-readiness rerun.
findings.does_not_block: Does not authorize auto-merge or branch-protection weakening.
findings.proof_required_to_close: Focused hardening tests, platform validation, exact-head lead review, remote CI, and final readiness comment pass.

flags.description: Branch-protection approval identity or explicit bypass rules for future lead-only lanes remain an infrastructure decision.
flags.next_action: Decide whether retained approval, a service identity, or explicit ruleset support is needed for future lead-only lanes.
flags.blocks: Automated merge identity or bypass design.
flags.does_not_block: Does not block draft-to-ready routing for human review.

flags.description: The implementation PR changes review-governance/autonomy machinery and therefore requires human review.
flags.next_action: Review the implementation PR after the readiness router marks the draft ready for human review.
flags.blocks: Autonomous merge of this governance change.
flags.does_not_block: Does not block publishing and marking the PR ready for human review.
flags.proof_required_to_close: PR readiness comment records READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW for the final remote head.

authorized_next: Use review:pr-readiness to classify draft PR readiness after the exact remote head has CI/checker and lead-review proof.
Use apply:pr-readiness only to post/update the idempotent marker comment and mark an eligible draft ready.
Route this governance implementation PR to human review; do not auto-merge it.
Do not infer generated-output approval, product authority, diagnostics, mastery, PV, Scale Gate 1, or student/product use from this sprint.
